title: Rollen und Berechtigungen
description: As an organisation admin, I want three distinct roles, so that only the right people can administer members, categories and flagged prompts.

acceptance_criteria.given: the acting user has the role ORG_ADMIN
acceptance_criteria.when: the user creates a new category
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 201 and the category belongs to the acting organisation
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-004-roles.feature: An organisation admin manages categories

acceptance_criteria.given: the acting user has the role DEVELOPER
acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to create a category
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 403 and no category is created
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-004-roles.feature: A developer is not allowed to administer categories

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt version is flagged with severity HIGH
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer attempts to release it while the security admin succeeds
acceptance_criteria.then: the developer receives 403 and the security admin receives 200 with status WAIVED
and: both attempts are recorded in the audit trail
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-004-roles.feature: Only the security admin may release a flagged prompt
